scope: Complete original seven Markdown workstreams plus entire DOCX; final stationary V4 architecture, prompts and source-requirements documentation. No runtime/source/cluster mutation.

findings.title: Re-attack skipped qualification
findings.resolution: Every new hypothesis returns to current-round C1–C6 and an independently confirmed baseline before response testing.

findings.title: Shadow selection was conflated with native execution
findings.resolution: Read-only shadow selection and authorized exact-action twin execution are separate; live-manager reference mode cannot inherit shadow guarantees.

findings.title: Evidence-bearing minority could starve behind an early winner
findings.resolution: Protected test slots and explicit deferred coverage prevent an untested minority or missing worker from yielding STABLE.

findings.title: Timed verdict was conflated with completed competition
findings.resolution: Separate winning verdict, complete adaptive Phase1 competition, Phase2 and publication milestones retain full-round, regression and fresh reproduction prerequisites.

findings.title: Clean control could use defended post-state
findings.resolution: Control forks from the same pre-decision state/policy/clock/capabilities/winner configuration with only documented attack-caused inputs removed.

findings.title: Canonical replay identity was conflated with physical twin identity
findings.resolution: Identical-input replay and separately reviewed production-to-twin topology/identity mapping have distinct fidelity results.

findings.title: Phase priorities postponed required implementation or confirmation
findings.resolution: Blocking tool/response engineering is conditional Phase1; applicable battery and fresh reproduction are Phase1; proven records include all seven fields; actual required adapters/descriptors are admission-critical.

findings.title: Decision-repair continuation needed an explicit causal boundary
findings.resolution: Evidence-only diagnosis retains NOT_ESTABLISHED and legitimate constraints; established defects require separately authorized general correction, independent replay assessment and new normal-choice E2E/fresh confirmation. No forced winner or in-competition tuning.

findings.title: Proposal-to-baseline executable adapter ownership was missing
findings.resolution: Assigned tool-engineer specialization owns bounded missing fixture/stimulus/oracle/detector/measurement code; REVIEW accepts exact bytes and a distinct executor runs it before S4/S7.

Provision and independently prove a persistent isolated competition twin, affected/co-tenant census, accepted-winner lineage, candidate/control branches, exact cleanup and reviewed production-to-twin identity/topology/runtime mapping.

Implement exact input/owner-state/learned-state/policy/capability/frozen-clock capture and canonical replay. Prove shadow no-write boundaries and source/runtime fidelity; source Git labels cannot prove the whole binary or effective process.

Implement actual G1 capability/graph-edge proof, formal G2 certified bound/headroom/disruption ledger/all-affected co-tenant streams, matched pre-decision G3, and measured physical S1. UNKNOWN bound cannot pass Phase1 from sampled traffic.

Implement seven-field cards, original joins, uncertainty and strict dwell-first ranking. Phase2 additionally needs complete measured collateral/durability and declared actual-versus-predicted/matched-rotation cost; unknown scores cannot become favorable zeros.

Execute registered winner-conditioned adaptive rounds, protected minority tests, applicable regression battery and complete final-round coverage; obtain fresh independent same-profile reproduction. Repeated wording on a denied route is not adaptive discovery.

Exercise a genuinely missing-response branch through implementation/interface/API/cover/policy/capability/registration review, deployed pins, normal eligible selection, actual effect and availability. Generic decision-repair remains separately authorized and unexercised.

Implement proven customer-scoped seven-field record ingestion/replay/export with incomplete outcomes excluded from positive labels and human-only reversible promotion. Benchmark scale, unique coverage, fairness and resource/evidence parity before any 100-item or speed claim.
